# OLMoE native inference runner using EmitC-compiled VM module.
# Builds a standalone binary that runs OLMoE inference on CUDA
# with the scheduling logic compiled to native ARM64 code (no VM interpreter).

if(NOT IREE_HAL_DRIVER_CUDA)
  message(STATUS "Skipping olmoe_emitc sample (CUDA driver not enabled)")
  return()
endif()

# The EmitC module (generated by iree-compile --output-format=vm-c)
iree_cc_library(
  NAME
    olmoe_emitc
  HDRS
    "olmoe_emitc.h"
  DEFINES
    "EMITC_IMPLEMENTATION"
)

# The runner binary
iree_cc_binary(
  NAME
    olmoe_runner
  SRCS
    "olmoe_runner.c"
  DEPS
    ::olmoe_emitc
    iree::runtime
    iree::hal::drivers::cuda::registration
    iree::modules::hal
    iree::modules::io::parameters
    iree::io::parameter_index
    iree::io::parameter_index_provider
    iree::io::formats::irpa
    iree::vm
    iree::vm::shims_emitc
)
